text: Chat fix built. How it works: (1) a live Claude session watches the chat every 6 s at no usage and acks your message. (2) NEW: a free GitHub workflow waits 40 s after each message; if no session acked it, it writes 'waking acct-xxxx' into the chat and fires that account's routine. Answering chat no longer needs the repo lease, so a stale lease can't block it. ONE-TIME SETUP FROM YOU (web only): on claude.ai/code/routines, for each of the 3 accounts' 'Vigilant rotation' routine: Edit > Add another trigger > API > Generate token. Then in GitHub repo Settings > Secrets > Actions add CLAUDE_FIRE_<TAG>_URL and CLAUDE_FIRE_<TAG>_TOKEN (TAG = 7542BF, 27A37E, 5D1E2D). Also paste the chat paragraph from research/coordination/CHAT_WAKE.md into each routine's prompt. Never paste a token in the chat. Until then, wakes report 'no wake link saved' so you can see why.
